title: Lanterns over Kiriyama
author: Aoi Mitsuda
description: A night-market lantern maker discovers that the lights she sells guide lost spirits home, and that someone is buying them all.

title: The Quiet Orbit
author: Ren Halloway
description: The last engineer on a drifting research station keeps receiving messages from a crew that left forty years ago.

title: Bento for Two
author: Mika Sonoda
description: Two rival cooking-club members agree to trade lunches every day until one of them admits the other is better.

title: Iron Tea House
author: Kenji Arawa
description: A retired fighter opens a tea house on the busiest street in the capital. Every customer wants a rematch.

title: Paper Cranes at Dawn
author: Yuna Kaede
description: A high-school senior folds one crane every morning for a friend in hospital, and starts leaving notes inside them.

title: Static & Snow
author: Oren Vale
description: A mountain town's only radio station starts broadcasting tomorrow's weather, and tomorrow's news.

title: The Cartographer's Apprentice
author: Lio Brandt
description: Maps drawn by her master change the land they describe. His apprentice has just found his last, unfinished one.

title: Neon Koi
author: Sora Ibuki
description: In a flooded megacity, a courier on a stolen hover-bike delivers the one package nobody else will touch.

title: Second-Hand Spells
author: Hana Moriyama
description: A thrift shop for used magic items, run by a clerk who can't cast a single spell herself.

title: The Long Relay
author: Taro Ishide
description: A washed-up university track team has one year to qualify for the hundred-kilometre New Year relay.

title: Moth & Meridian
author: Elise Marrow
description: A night-shift clockmaker and a lighthouse keeper exchange letters by moth for a whole winter.

title: Garden of Small Robots
author: Pim Okada
description: An old botanist builds a dozen tiny robots to tend her garden after she moves away. They have opinions.

title: Salt Road
author: Idris Kolt
description: Caravan guards, a runaway scholar and a camel with a grudge cross a desert that keeps rearranging itself.

title: After the Bell
author: Nami Tachibana
description: The school's three most unlucky students form a club to help everyone else's luck, with mixed results.

title: Hollow Crown Academy
author: Viktor Ashe
description: A commoner enrols in a royal academy by accident, and the entrance exam turns out to be a real war.

title: Tidewater Diner
author: June Calloway
description: Regulars at a seaside diner tell the new waitress the stories behind the photos on the wall.

title: Wolfsbane Express
author: Greta Holm
description: A night train that only runs on full moons, and a conductor who never checks tickets.

title: The Ninth Kitchen
author: Daichi Fuse
description: Eight restaurants failed in this building. The ninth is run by someone who can't cook, and it's full every night.

title: Starlit Archive
author: Celeste Ono
description: Every book in the observatory library records a star. Someone has started tearing out pages.

title: Copper & Clay
author: Ansel Reed
description: Two potters in a river town compete for the same royal commission across one very long summer.

title: The Last Arcade
author: Kai Morrow
description: The final arcade in a city of VR headsets, kept alive by a clerk, a champion and one haunted cabinet.

title: Foxfire Post Office
author: Rin Asahi
description: A country post office that also delivers mail for foxes, tanuki and the occasional mountain god.

title: Glass Harbor
author: Mara Lind
description: A glassblower returns to the harbour town she left, and to the ferry captain who never did.

title: Thunder in the Rice Fields
author: Goro Nakabe
description: A thunder spirit crash-lands in a farming village and is put to work until the harvest is in.
